records.name: Review of Economic Perspectives
records.publisher: Faculty of Business and Economics, Mendel University in Brno
records.scope_notes: General economics and economic policy, including theoretical and empirical work. Existing-data policy studies can fit; practical relevance to Central and Eastern Europe is particularly welcomed. Submissions in English are accepted throughout the year.

route.conditions: No submission fee or APC under the current university site. Preferred manuscript length is 10–20 pages excluding references. Current ownership is Mendel University from 2025; older Masaryk University descriptions are stale.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the fee policy and author instructions reviewed.

fee_evidence.note: Current university About page explicitly excludes submission fees and article-processing charges and says submissions are accepted throughout the year.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in this expansion pass; peer review and fee-free access do not imply easy acceptance.

records.name: European Journal of Government and Economics
records.publisher: Publication Service, University of A Coruña
records.scope_notes: Original research on government and institutions in the economy and economic analysis of policymaking. Existing-data evaluation of public finance or health-system policy can fit when the contribution is economic; generic clinical articles do not follow from this scope.

route.conditions: Official author information excludes submission fees and APCs. Double-blind review follows editorial screening. Approximately 7,000 words is a target, with no absolute length limit in the author instructions. No institutional affiliation or society membership is required by the reviewed policy.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the fee policy and author instructions reviewed.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific author page explicitly says it applies neither article-processing charges nor submission fees.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in this expansion pass; peer review and fee-free access do not imply easy acceptance.

records.name: Central European Economic Journal
records.publisher: Faculty of Economic Sciences, University of Warsaw, in partnership with Paradigm Publishing Services
records.scope_notes: Theoretical and empirical economics/finance and interdisciplinary research; explicit areas include policy evaluation, econometrics, machine learning, population and household well-being. Central/Eastern Europe is emphasized; other-country work needs an international contribution. Systematic or critical reviews are accepted; opinion papers are confined to special issues.

route.conditions: Current journal-specific instructions exclude submission and article-processing fees and keep submissions open year-round. English manuscripts, normally no more than 40 A4 pages. For articles published from November 2026, explicit declarations about generative-AI use or non-use and conflicts are mandatory; tools cannot be authors.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the fee policy and author instructions reviewed.

fee_evidence.note: Official four-page submission instructions state no submission or article-processing fees; the same document specifies year-round submissions and manuscript requirements.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in this expansion pass; peer review and fee-free access do not imply easy acceptance.

ai_policy.summary: From November 2026, manuscripts must declare whether and how generative AI was used, name tools and purposes, and retain human authorship and responsibility.

records.name: Economía (PUCP)
records.publisher: Department of Economics, Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú
records.scope_notes: Original theoretical and empirical research across economics, with an emphasis on Latin America and an international author community. Existing-data economic studies and economically substantive methods can fit. Research-data guidance encourages sharing supporting data, software, code and models; this is not a standalone data/software journal.

route.conditions: Journal About page states it charges no fees to authors or readers and is institutionally funded, without an affiliation or membership condition. Specific author-guideline and AI pages were bot-blocked on direct retrieval; relevant official search excerpts were available. AI excerpt calls for human responsibility and disclosure of tools and use, and excludes AI-generated/manipulated images; recheck full instructions before submission.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: the official policy broadly excludes fees to authors.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal Revenue section states it charges no fees to authors or readers and that institutional resources fully support publication.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in this expansion pass; peer review and fee-free access do not imply easy acceptance.

ai_policy.summary: Official indexed excerpt permits supportive AI assistance with disclosure and human responsibility but excludes AI-generated or manipulated images. Full page was bot-blocked during this pass.

notes: Four additional university-published diamond journals; IDs and names were checked against research/discovery/economics.json. No duplicates and no repository/preprint records added.

Fee findings use current official venue/publisher pages or journal-specific instructions; no waiver, institutional read-and-publish agreement, or mandatory membership is needed under the retrieved policies. Documentary verification is not acceptance assurance.
All difficulty bands remain unknown; no citation metrics, indexing rankings or acceptance odds are inferred. Independent fee, ranking and skeptical reviews remain necessary.

Review of Economic Perspectives changed university ownership in 2025. Use the current Mendel University source rather than older Masaryk University/DOAJ descriptions. Its About page and footer display different Creative Commons variants, so no precise license is asserted in this record.

Economía PUCP About/fee and peer-review pages were retrieved, but author instructions and AI pages were blocked on direct fetch. Their official search excerpts were treated as weaker evidence; inspect the full current instructions before manuscript preparation.

Croatian Economic Survey was considered but not added: the official Hrčak portal https://hrcak.srce.hr/croatian-economic-survey labels it diamond and active, but the linked publisher site timed out and retrieved author instructions did not explicitly settle submission/publication charges. Third-party no-fee listings were not substituted for a complete venue-issued policy.

Journal of Economic Integration was considered but not added after https://www.e-jei.org/authors/authors.php returned 403 and an explicit official fee policy was not recovered. No inference of fee-free status was made from open access.
No accounts were created, venues contacted, manuscripts submitted or remote writes performed.
